moments.text: Grey-scale infrared view of a mottled grey surface, crosshair at centre. A tiny bright dot moves about near the crosshair, mostly above and right of it.
A square tracking box with a small label opens around the crosshair; the dot drifts past its upper-right corner and away to the lower right.
Faint vertical bands cover the picture; the dots are hard to make out for long stretches.
The picture flashes bright, then shows bold dark vertical bands for a few seconds before settling.
With the bands gone, tiny bright dots show again, passing right of and above the crosshair, then low across the frame.
A bright dot slides down and left of the crosshair; a tracking box with a label opens and the dot passes through it.
A rippled wave texture fills the frame, then the picture flashes.
Grainy picture with a dark patch on the right; no dots stand out.
The picture turns flat and soft with pale curved bands until the clip ends.
